sloka: तेन भाण्डेन सम्कीर्णम् श्रीमद् राज निवेशनम् ।अशोभत तदा भूयः शारदम् गगनम् यथा ॥२-७८-१८॥
transliteration: tena bhāṇḍena samkīrṇam śrīmad rāja niveśanam ।aśobhata tadā bhūyaḥ śāradam gaganam yathā ॥2-78-18॥

translations.english: The resplendent royal palace, strewn all over with several ornaments on the ground shone like the autumnal sky (studded with innumerable stars).
